description: This file defines the RemotePlugin class within the WPEFramework Plugin Rust namespace. The class implements the Rust::IPlugin interface and provides methods for plugin lifecycle management, communication, and interaction with the host environment. It includes method declarations for initialization, deinitialization, activation, deactivation, message handling, and process management, along with private members for internal state and communication handling.
